name: Supabase
tagline: Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions — a lot of surface for a newcomer.
firstWin: your first project's dashboard, open and showing Healthy
path: create an organization (name it, choose the free plan)
create a new project — name it, set a strong database password (the Generate button works), pick the closest region
click Create new project and wait for it to provision
land on the project dashboard — once it shows Healthy, they're in and onboarding is DONE
optional: If they want their API keys afterward, they live under Settings → API Keys (Project URL is on that same page). This is a bonus, not required to finish.

knowledge.text: On the Create Project screen, the database password must be strong. The 'Generate a password' link fills a strong one automatically — click it if theirs is rejected as weak.
Pick the region closest to the user or their users — it can't be changed after the project is created, only by making a new project.

knowledge.keywords: api keys anon publishable url settings
knowledge.text: The Project URL and API keys live under Settings → API Keys. The 'publishable'/anon key is safe for browser code; the secret/service key must stay server-side.
The Free plan is enough to start: 2 free projects, 500MB database, 1GB storage. You choose the plan when creating the organization.
A new project takes about 2 minutes to provision. The dashboard shows 'Setting up' then 'Healthy' when it's ready to use.
